items_flat.title_en: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims
items_flat.title_zh: 遭解僱的 OpenAI 安全研究員否認違規，指因提出安全疑慮
items_flat.summary_en: Three former OpenAI safety researchers, Mikita Balesni, Tomek Korbak and Jasmine Wang, published a letter saying they believe they were fired for prioritizing safety. OpenAI said Friday it parted ways with them after an investigation found they violated policies on handling sensitive information, and research leaders said the decision was not retaliation for raising concerns.
items_flat.summary_zh: 前 OpenAI 安全研究員 Mikita Balesni、Tomek Korbak 與 Jasmine Wang 公開信函，稱他們認為自己是因優先考量安全而被解僱。OpenAI 周五表示，調查發現三人違反敏感資訊處理政策後才分道揚鑣，研究主管並稱決定並非因提出疑慮而報復。
items_flat.analysis_en: The dispute puts OpenAI’s external monitoring commitments under a public test: the researchers say coordination with outside evaluators was part of the job, while the company frames it as a trust breach. What remains unresolved is which account the board and remaining safety staff will treat as binding.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這場爭議把 OpenAI 對外監控承諾放到公開檢驗：研究員稱與外部評估機構協調本是職務，公司則定性為信任破裂。仍未確定的是董事會與留任安全人員會以哪一種說法為準。
items_flat.quote: I believe we were fired for prioritising safety over the near-term interests of OpenAI as a corporation
items_flat.quote_zh: 我相信我們被解僱，是因為把安全置於 OpenAI 作為公司的短期利益之上。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI’s September run rate near $50B, year-end forecast still $70B
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 九月年化營收近 500 億美元，年底仍看 700 億
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters, citing a person familiar with the matter, reported that OpenAI told investors its September annualized revenue was almost $50 billion, below an earlier figure near $70 billion that was used for comparison with Anthropic. Bloomberg reported Friday that OpenAI now expects annualized revenue to reach or exceed $70 billion by year-end, with enterprise growth cited as the main driver.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透引述知情人士報導，OpenAI 向投資人表示九月年化營收接近 500 億美元，低於先前用來與 Anthropic 比較的近 700 億數字。彭博周五報導，OpenAI 目前預期年底年化營收達到或超過 700 億美元，主要來自企業業務成長。
items_flat.analysis_en: The gap is a definition problem as much as a miss: OpenAI’s figure reportedly excludes some cloud-partner sales that Anthropic counts. Until the company publishes a consistent run-rate definition, the $50 billion and $70 billion numbers should not be treated as the same metric.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 落差既是未達標，也是口徑問題：報導稱 OpenAI 的數字未計入 Anthropic 會算進的部分雲端夥伴銷售。在公司公布一致的年化定義前，500 億與 700 億不應視為同一指標。

items_flat.title_en: USA Today Co. sues OpenAI for over $250 million
items_flat.title_zh: USA Today 控告 OpenAI，求償逾 2.5 億美元
items_flat.summary_en: USA Today Co. and newspapers it owns sued OpenAI in Manhattan federal court, alleging the company copied hundreds of thousands of articles to train the models behind ChatGPT. The complaint seeks damages in excess of $250 million and an order blocking the alleged infringement. OpenAI had not immediately commented, Reuters reported.
items_flat.summary_zh: USA Today 公司及其旗下報紙在曼哈頓聯邦法院控告 OpenAI，指其複製數十萬篇文章來訓練 ChatGPT 背後的模型。訴狀求償超過 2.5 億美元，並要求法院制止所指侵權。路透報導，OpenAI 當時尚未立即回應。
items_flat.analysis_en: This adds a large newspaper group to the existing New York training-data docket, but it does not by itself change OpenAI’s fair-use defense. The open question is whether a court will order limits on already-trained models, not only damages.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這把大型報業集團加入紐約既有的訓練資料訴訟，但本身並未改變 OpenAI 的合理使用抗辯。關鍵仍是法院會不會限制已訓練完成的模型，而不只是判賠。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI says it banned Russian and Iranian false-front operations
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 稱已封鎖俄羅斯與伊朗的「假門面」操作
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it banned two influence operations, one originating in Russia and one in Iran, that used its models alongside conventional tactics to run false-front journalists and a think tank. It rated the Russia-origin case Category 5 on the Breakout Scale, the highest it says it has disrupted, and the Iran-origin case Category 4, because content reached mainstream outlets.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示已封鎖來自俄羅斯與伊朗的兩起影響操作，行為者把模型與傳統手法併用，經營假記者與智庫門面。公司依 Breakout Scale 將俄羅斯案評為第 5 級，稱是其迄今阻斷的最高級別，伊朗案為第 4 級，因內容進入主流媒體。
items_flat.analysis_en: The report shows AI being used more for drafting, translation and internal reporting than for inventing a new influence channel. Reach still depended on landing copy in real outlets, so exposure may matter more than model bans alone.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這份報告顯示，AI 較多用於起草、翻譯與內部報告，而不是開創新的影響管道。觸及仍取決於稿件能否登上真實媒體，因此曝光本身可能比單純封帳更關鍵。
items_flat.quote: We recently banned two IO—one from Russia and one from Iran—that used our models in combination with more traditional techniques and technologies to support sophisticated “false front” entities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們最近封鎖了兩起影響操作，一來自俄羅斯、一來自伊朗，它們把我們的模型與較傳統的技術併用，以支撐精密的「假門面」實體。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches Cyber Mission for grids and open source
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動 Cyber Mission，涵蓋電網與開源軟體
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched the Cyber Mission, starting with a Critical Infrastructure Defense Program and OSS Scanner. Founding partners include Accenture, CrowdStrike, Deloitte, Palo Alto Networks, PwC and Rockwell Automation. OSS Scanner sends enrolled projects free, model-generated vulnerability reports with a proof of concept and suggested fix, without human review; Anthropic says it expects a true-positive rate above 90 percent.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 啟動 Cyber Mission，先推出關鍵基礎設施防禦計畫與 OSS Scanner。創始夥伴包括 Accenture、CrowdStrike、Deloitte、Palo Alto Networks、PwC 與 Rockwell Automation。OSS Scanner 免費向登記專案寄出模型生成的漏洞報告，含概念驗證與建議修補，且不經人工審閱；Anthropic 稱預期真陽性率逾 90%。
items_flat.analysis_en: The useful shift is distribution: frontier cyber capability is being pushed to operational-technology vendors and maintainers, not only to a gated verification program. The stated sub-90-percent error band means unreviewed reports can still create triage load.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 真正的變化在配送：前沿網路能力被推向工控廠商與維護者，而不只留在封閉驗證計畫。公司自己說的低於九成真陽性，代表未經審閱的報告仍可能增加分流負擔。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re launching the Anthropic Cyber Mission, a long-term commitment to securing the systems everyone depends on.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們啟動 Anthropic Cyber Mission，這是一項長期承諾，要保護所有人依賴的系統。

items_flat.title_en: Google Cloud introduces a universal Gemini agent for work
items_flat.title_zh: Google Cloud 推出通用工作用 Gemini agent
items_flat.summary_en: At Gemini at Work 2026, Google Cloud announced the Gemini agent, described as one agent for work that plans tasks, uses skills and tools, connects to customers’ business systems, and chooses a model for the job with cost controls and enterprise admin. The Verge reported it is in private preview for enterprise customers and can act as a coworker agent with its own email identity.
items_flat.summary_zh: 在 Gemini at Work 2026，Google Cloud 宣布 Gemini agent，稱其為單一工作代理人，可規劃任務、使用技能與工具、連接客戶的業務系統，並依工作選擇模型，附成本控制與企業管理。The Verge 報導它正對企業客戶封閉預覽，並可作為有獨立電子郵件身分的同事代理人。
items_flat.analysis_en: Google is productizing the same “one window, many models” pattern already visible in rival workplace agents. Private preview means the routing, identity and admin claims are not yet broadly testable.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Google 正在把對手職場代理人已出現的「一個視窗、多個模型」做成產品。封閉預覽意味路由、身分與管理這些說法尚未能廣泛驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today at Gemini at Work 2026, Google Cloud announced the Gemini agent, a universal agent for work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天在 Gemini at Work 2026，Google Cloud 宣布 Gemini agent，一個通用的工作代理人。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI ships Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 為 GPT-6.1 Sol 推出 Ultrafast 模式
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI added Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol in the Responses API. Developers call gpt-6.1-sol with service_tier set to ultrafast to shorten the gap between output tokens. It is available to all API users subject to rate limits, with global processing and US and EU data residency.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 Responses API 為 GPT-6.1 Sol 新增 Ultrafast 模式。開發者以 gpt-6.1-sol 並將 service_tier 設為 ultrafast，以縮短輸出 token 之間的間隔。所有 API 用戶可在速率限制下使用，支援全球處理以及美國與歐盟資料落地。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a serving-tier change, not a new model. Whether it changes production choices depends on the unpublished latency-quality tradeoff and the separate Ultrafast price, which the release note points to but does not state.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是服務層級調整，不是新模型。會不會改變正式環境的選擇，取決於尚未在發布說明中寫明的延遲與品質取捨，以及另外列出的 Ultrafast 價格。
items_flat.quote: Added Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol in the Responses API. Use gpt-6.1-sol with service_tier: "ultrafast" to reduce the time between generated output tokens.
items_flat.quote_zh: 已在 Responses API 為 GPT-6.1 Sol 新增 Ultrafast 模式。以 gpt-6.1-sol 搭配 service_tier: "ultrafast"，可縮短產生輸出 token 之間的時間。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic commits $150 million to the Genesis Mission
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 承諾 1.5 億美元支持 Genesis Mission
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said it will commit $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission, a US federal effort to speed scientific discovery with AI, and make Claude and technical support available to more than 15 participating agencies, including NASA, NIH and NSF.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示將在三年內投入 1.5 億美元支持美國聯邦 Genesis Mission，以 AI 加速科學發現，並向包括 NASA、NIH 與 NSF 在內的 15 個以上參與機構提供 Claude 與技術支援。
items_flat.analysis_en: The pledge ties Claude distribution to a federal science program rather than a new model launch. Impact depends on how many agency workloads actually move onto Claude, which the announcement does not quantify.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這筆承諾把 Claude 的供給綁到聯邦科學計畫，而不是新模型發布。影響取決於有多少機關工作負載真的轉到 Claude，公告並未量化。
items_flat.quote: Anthropic is deepening its support for American scientific research by committing $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission.
items_flat.quote_zh: Anthropic 正加深對美國科學研究的支持，承諾在三年內向 Genesis Mission 投入 1.5 億美元。

google.summary_en: At Gemini at Work 2026, Google Cloud announced the Gemini agent, described as one agent for work that plans tasks, uses skills and tools, connects to customers’ business systems, and chooses a model for the job with cost controls and enterprise admin. The Verge reported it is in private preview for enterprise customers and can act as a coworker agent with its own email identity.
google.summary_zh: 在 Gemini at Work 2026，Google Cloud 宣布 Gemini agent，稱其為單一工作代理人，可規劃任務、使用技能與工具、連接客戶的業務系統，並依工作選擇模型，附成本控制與企業管理。The Verge 報導它正對企業客戶封閉預覽，並可作為有獨立電子郵件身分的同事代理人。
google.analysis_en: Google is productizing the same “one window, many models” pattern already visible in rival workplace agents. Private preview means the routing, identity and admin claims are not yet broadly testable.
google.analysis_zh: Google 正在把對手職場代理人已出現的「一個視窗、多個模型」做成產品。封閉預覽意味路由、身分與管理這些說法尚未能廣泛驗證。
google.quote: Today at Gemini at Work 2026, Google Cloud announced the Gemini agent, a universal agent for work.
google.quote_zh: 今天在 Gemini at Work 2026，Google Cloud 宣布 Gemini agent，一個通用的工作代理人。

brief_en: In the last 12 hours, former OpenAI safety researchers disputed their firing, while reports put September annualized revenue near $50 billion. Anthropic launched a critical-infrastructure cyber mission, Google Cloud introduced an enterprise Gemini agent, and USA Today sued over training data.
brief_zh: OpenAI前安全研究員質疑遭解僱，年化營收近500億美元。Anthropic啟動關鍵基礎設施防禦，Google推出企業Gemini agent。
